item.title: [ Mod ] "Smile HD" & "Caramelldansen" Tank Music Mod
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 5
Replace the terrifying Tank theme with pure chaotic energy! This mod swaps the default Tank battle tracks with two iconic internet meme classics. 🎵 Tracklist: 🎧 Caramelldansen – Caramella Girls - (Replaces standard Tank theme) 🎧 Smile HD Remix – Foozogz - (Replaces Taank theme / Finale Tank) 📌 Features: Compatibility: Replaces only the standard Tank music files (tank.wav and taank.wav). It works across all standard campaigns and custom maps using default Tank tracks. Audio Quality: Level-balanced to ensure the beat hits hard without drowning out Special Infected audio cues or team voicelines. 💡 Note: If you have other modded Tank music installed, make sure to disable them or give this mod higher priority in your addon manager to avoid conflicts, also don´t forget let me know any problem that you could have with the mod.

item.title: [ Mod ] "Tank And Concert Music Mod"
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 6
Take the Dark Carnival concert to a whole new level of adrenaline! This mod replaces the original Midnight Riders tracklist with two heavy rock and thrash metal bangers that will make surviving the hordes and Tanks feel insanely epic. 🎵 Tracklist: "Song 1" (Replaces Midnight Ride): 🎧- Black Betty – Spiderbait "Song 2" (Replaces One Bad Man): 🎧- World Painted Blood – Slayer Tank Music (Concert Only): Tanks spawning during the concert event will also rock out to these tracks but modified to adapt to those parts. 📌 Features: Compatibility: Only replaces the audio files for the concert stage. It won't affect other campaigns or general Tank music outside of Dark Carnival. Audio Quality: Level-balanced to blend smoothly with standard in-game sound effects and survivor voicelines. 💡 Note: If you have other concert music mods installed, make sure to disable them or give this one higher priority in your addon manager to prevent audio conflicts.

item.title: [ Mod ] Assault [Mutation]
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 4
NOTES: INSTALL THE REQUIRED PRESET (OR ANY OTHER PRESET) PLEASE DON'T USE ANY JOCKEY OR TANK SOUND MODS (MUSIC IS FINE) AI mods such as Left 4 Bots may be incompatible! Works best in CQB/Claustrophobic campaigns! (Mostly) Compatible with weapon stat scripts! A proof of concept mutation that pits players against heavily armed soldiers instead of zombies! Originally I had way more ideas for this but due to limits in the engine and my vscripting skills, maybe someone else can complete this! Credits: ChimiChamo - Original Rochelle AI Me - Editing, additional features
